title: TSFM-Lens: comparative mechanistic interpretability for time-series foundation models
description: Mechanistic interpretability of time-series foundation models (TSFMs), comparing models with very different architectures on equal grounds. Two separately installable packages: tsfm-benchmark (leakage-audited, sealed, ground-truth-labeled synthetic benchmark corpora and their validation) and tsfm-lens (a layered analysis pipeline that produces one interactive HTML report, with held-out confirmation of registered hypotheses on a sealed private corpus).
